product_one_liner.value: Open Dental provides customizable dental practice-management software for dental offices and practices of any size.
product_one_liner.notes: The company homepage describes it as comprehensive, customizable dental practice-management software for practices of any size.

pricing_page.notes: The page publicly lists software, support, and service rates.

named_customers.notes: The customer reference page does not name customer practices or organizations; it says references can be requested and matched by location, specialty, or practice size. The testimonials use individual names or initials, not named customer organizations.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees; the company's history post says it has over 300 employees.

hq_location.notes: The LinkedIn company profile identifies Salem, Oregon, United States, as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The LinkedIn company profile gives 2003; the company's About page says it was founded in 2003.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index mainly features product highlights, version updates, and practice-use content. The engineering search found one engineer interview with high-level DevOps context, not at least two engineering-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The site links to public documentation, including an extensive manual and technical resources with multiple topics, plus API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current company careers page lists Dental Assistant/Software Support and Daycare Aide; neither is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: I found no public statement identifying an AI model or model provider after checking the product documentation, blog, and available AI/security/privacy search results.

compliance_certs.notes: The company says its software helps a customer's practice become HIPAA compliant and places security responsibility on the practice; it does not claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification for itself on this page.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn identifies Open Dental as unfunded and says it has raised no funding rounds; therefore there is no round date or amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile states the company has raised no rounds, so it did not raise in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current employment page lists Dental Assistant/Software Support and Daycare Aide, not SDR, BDR, sales development, or account executive positions.

launched_6mo.notes: The company published a Patient Dashboard feature-highlight post on 2026-10-13, within the six-month window ending 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I found no verifiable dated announcement or profile establishing a C-level or VP-level join or departure in the period. The available company history and leadership information are insufficient to establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The supplemental services and products page names these CRM platforms in connection with integrations for Open Dental; this is an integration signal, not proof that Open Dental itself uses them internally.
